title: An image without app/lib/chat-system-prompt.md can still deploy; gate the deploy on it without touching routing
evidence: Closed by decision 2026-11-26 (Brad: "go with your recommendations" on "Two server items to close"): no deploy gate. Chat already refuses with no model call and sends one Sentry error when the prompt is missing (T28, US-15 AC65; the backstop in app/lib/chat.server.ts, H407). /healthz stays the routing check on both apps (fly.toml, fly.edu.toml), unchanged. The options weighed (a Fly Machine check, a deploy.yml step, a separate /healthz/chat) are not built.
